result.rationale: The new loop in createAllCalendarEvents iterates over every entry in event.destinationCalendar, and for destinations without credentialId the else branch runs `Promise.all` over all calendarCredentials matching that integration. The diff makes destinationCalendar an array (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts) and pushes multiple team members' calendars in handleNewBooking.ts, so N credentialId-less destinations of the same integration each trigger creation across all M matching credentials — M×N duplicates, a behavior that could not occur with the pre-diff single destinationCalendar object.

judged_text: Duplicate event creation when multiple destinations lack `credentialId` (`packages/core/EventManager.ts:~364–369`): the else branch runs `Promise.all` over all `this.calendarCredentials` of that integration per destination, so multiple hosts with credentialId-less destination calendars of the same integration produce M×N inserts and user-visible duplicate events on the same calendar, wasting provider API quota.

record.issue_text: Duplicate event creation when multiple destinations lack `credentialId` (`packages/core/EventManager.ts:~364–369`): the else branch runs `Promise.all` over all `this.calendarCredentials` of that integration per destination, so multiple hosts with credentialId-less destination calendars of the same integration produce M×N inserts and user-visible duplicate events on the same calendar, wasting provider API quota.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` calls, for each `destination` without `credentialId`, `Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(...createEvent(c, event)))`. Because `destinationCalendarCredentials` is derived only from `destination.integration`, multiple destinations of the same integration that lack `credentialId` will each re-run `createEvent` for the same set of credentials, producing M×N inserts. This is verifiable from the diff, and `createEvent` is invoked without passing the destination externalId in that else branch, so repeated iterations can create user-visible duplicates and waste API quota.
